applied.change: Added state_types[39] tool call and result record, owned by tool access, home_today gap because the MCP endpoint is live with zero tools registered (F-a6-03), with lifetime run, boundaries process/vm/org and a pinning_risk against storing the protocol frame instead of a mapped call. Listed in gaps as tool-call-record-home with a research_query.

Added state_types[40] streaming partial output and in-turn frame buffer, owned by agent runtime, lifetime turn. home_today is the ACP frame stream from the runtime in the microVM, with the measured cancellation behaviour of about eight seconds and zero trailing frames (F-a3-03, F-a3-09); the recoverable position is stated as platform state so a one-shot or batch runner can serve the same interface.

Added state_types[41] dispatch-level retry attempt on the dispatch seam, distinct from loop iteration, carrying cause class, backoff and attempt number so a transient re-try and a judged re-run are never conflated. Gap row dispatch-retry-home.

Added state_types[42] secret rotation record at the mandate broker, lifetime forever, recording rotation version and the leases it invalidates; the record holds a version and a validity window, never the material. Gap row secret-rotation-home.

Agreed with the nit and added state_types[43] feature flag and config-version rollout, distinct from the per-run resolved manifest, sourced to the measured configuration overlay (F-a7-04) and to the evaluate-gate-canary pattern (X-end-to-end-026). Not declared out of scope, because TARGET T4 puts a self-improvement loop in scope. Gap row feature-flag-home.

Added state_types[44] model version pin behind a resolved routing class, written at dispatch time and read by evaluation and provenance, so an evaluation baseline can be replayed against the same inference behaviour. Gap row model-version-pin-home.

Agreed with the nit and added state_types[45] cache entry under model access, sourced to PASS.md A4 context caching at batch pricing (F-a4-08) and to per-engine caching differences (REF-8-02); the row states that the platform records only that a call was served from a cache and what it cost, not the cache itself. Gap row cache-entry-home.

Added state_types[46] dead-letter record, owned by work intake at admission and by durable execution for step-level exhaustion, keeping the normalised envelope beside the native message so a replay does not need the producer to still exist. Gap row dead-letter-home.

Added state_types[47] rate-limit window per actor or tenant under tenancy, enforced at the same choke points budget already names and refused as a typed problem, distinct from the dollar ceiling and the idempotency lease. Gap row rate-limit-window-home.

Added state_types[48] consent and standing authorisation grant, owned by identity with the mandate broker issuing against it, lifetime forever until revoked, read by policy and identity at every admission. Gap row consent-grant-home.

Promoted both myopia_check prose items to full rows: state_types[49] GPU and fleet capacity as a routing input and state_types[50] concurrency admission and backpressure queue, each with owner, home_today, home_ideal, written_by, read_by, lifetime, crosses_boundaries and pinning_risk. Added promoted_to back-references on myopia_check[9] and myopia_check[7]. Gap rows gpu-capacity-home and concurrency-admission-home. Also added the three further missing kinds the review listed but did not raise as findings: state_types[51] notification delivery state, state_types[52] GPU and fleet physical placement, state_types[53] multi-turn human conversation and thread state, so all fifteen missing state types are now rows.

Added entry_matrix rows for the six uncovered state types across all four entries: artifact and its digest, work graph, provenance attestation, isolation admission and containment report, model routing selection and claim ticket, resolved manifest and effective configuration. Twenty-four rows, each with minimal_caller_action Nothing, because all six are cross-cutting guarantees the platform applies rather than the caller requests. Also added the missing telemetry span row to the external system or agent entry, which is the same class of omission.

Added agent profile record and mandate / credential rows to the human, event and schedule entries, six rows, because T6.3 says any entry can call agents and a dispatched step that must spend, deploy or send needs a scoped mandate whichever door produced the plan.

Added tool_entries[19] for firecracker-cell-long@.service as a distinct row citing F-a2-03, and stated in must_stay_loose that the runtime ceiling is a declared parameter of admission rather than a property of which systemd unit ran.

Closed three of the five from research and one from a skill: tool_entries[7] trace storage now names OTLP Specification 1.11.0 with the backend store deliberately left open (X-gap-c-004), tool_entries[8] blob store now names the S3-compatible API and OCI Distribution (X-gap-c-005), tool_entries[17] Ansible now names in-toto Attestation Framework v1.0.2 for the effective-configuration attestation (X-gap-c-001), and tool_entries[9] approve.service is resolved by M-019. The remaining second-adapter gaps on gateway-db-1, Ansible and Tailscale are explicitly deferred in the rows under owner decision T-t8-01, which rules host-absent facts design work rather than research.

Added an impact_map entry for the approval surface changing from a request/response unit to a queued or streamed surface, naming the human-interaction surface adapter and the notification-delivery adapter, the four-decision resume fixture and the end-to-end test, and the skills cap-human-interaction, cap-human-interaction-implement, compose-approval and xc-correlation.

Added two impact_map entries: an ACP major-version revision, distinct from a runtime swap, citing the v2 Draft record (X-gap-a-001) and naming every agent-runtime adapter plus the streaming frame buffer; and memory going from absent to designed and then changing store or scope model, naming the memory adapter, the state seam's query surface and the agent-runtime context contract.

Corrected the contradiction against cap-human-interaction. tool_entries[9] second_adapter now records the AG-UI browser-stream adapter the skill already carries, with its swap procedure and its adapters_run >= 2 criterion, quoting X-entry-composition-021; its status is no longer gap. open_questions[6] no longer claims no swap candidate is recorded and now asks the question that is actually open, whether a streaming surface may own the ask or only render a durable record. Re-checked every other second_adapter gap against the skills named as owners: gateway-db-1, Ansible and Tailscale have no capability row in PASS.md B3 at all, so none was similarly stale.

Relabelled entry_matrix to cap-work-intake's and T6.2's four categories: human, event, schedule, and external system or agent. The former agent entry is now external system or agent and the former external entry, which carries event subscription, is now event. Every row also carries entry_kind, the EntryEnvelope kind enum value the skill defines - human, event, schedule, external - and entry_enumeration naming which enumeration is being cited. open_questions[4] now records that labels are settled and normativity is not.

Applied the gap-closure-a research to standards_at_play rather than the weaker skill note. Agent Client Protocol is now version 2 in Draft released 20 July 2026 with wire version 1 current stable (X-gap-a-001, X-cap-agent-runtime-004); OpenAI-compatible completions is none found (X-gap-a-002); Rego / OPA is OPA 1.0 with Rego v1 syntax from v0.59.0 (X-gap-a-003); workload identity is none found, SPIFFE being managed by a stability framework (X-gap-a-004); AG-UI is none found (X-gap-a-005); OpenAPI 3.1.0 and AsyncAPI 3.0.0 with 3.1.0 minor (X-gap-a-006). Every version_gap_ref is removed and each row carries version_status search-sourced or none-found. Also promoted the gap-closure-c standards into standards_at_play as four new rows: in-toto Attestation Framework v1.0.2, MADR, OCI Artifact Manifest Specification, and the S3-compatible object API with OCI Distribution.

Added a usability section with six rows. One caller row records the half of TARGET T3 that is met: one required declaration for the common case, against build-simplicity-budget's stated count. Four builder rows, one common task per entry, count the blueprint rows and skill files a builder must read - human 23 rows and 47 skill files, 70 reads; event 23 and 45, 68; schedule 23 and 47, 70; external system or agent 22 and 45, 67 - against a proposed budget of one entry card plus at most ten skill files, eleven reads. None is met. A sixth row records the total of 91 entry_matrix rows and states that until the per-entry card exists, T3 should be read as a caller-facing claim that is met and a builder-facing claim that is not. A new open question asks the owner to decide whether the builder-facing budget is the platform's to own.

declined.why: The finding's own proposed_change is None: it is a check that passed, not a gap, so there was nothing to apply and no blueprint edit was made. The check was re-run after the relabelling instead: a scan of all ninety-one entry_matrix minimal_caller_action strings for LiteLLM, Langfuse, OPA, Firecracker, goose, Temporal, MCP, Tailscale, ClickHouse, MinIO, Postgres, Ansible, SGLang, Redis, AG-UI, ACP, A2A, CloudEvents and OpenAI returns zero matches, so the check still passes over the thirty-one rows added here.

summary: Twenty-one of twenty-two myopia findings applied, one declined because it proposed no change. The blueprint now carries every state kind the review named as missing, entry labels that agree with cap-work-intake's own contract and TARGET T6.2, the second human-interaction adapter the skill already recorded, the versions and standards gap-closure-a and gap-closure-c found, and the first measurement of what the platform costs a builder rather than a caller.
